summary: Official Almada municipal GeoPortal and Portugal DGT/SNIC cadastral sources were discovered and inspected. The current SNIC configuration exposed only a São Brás de Alportel parcel layer; no Almada-specific safe parcel response, native ID, schema, CRS, or polygon was verified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Portuguese discovery queries were executed and recorded in city-375-almada.json. The official viewer shell and configuration returned successfully. A bounded anonymous WFS capabilities request was connection-reset before response. The municipal portal shell returned, but its tested relative JavaScript path did not expose current service configuration.
cityOrLocalCustodian: Câmara Municipal de Almada is evidenced as the local GeoPortal custodian for public geographic information. DGT/SNIC is the national cadastral custodian. Neither yielded a verified Almada parcel endpoint in this attempt.
routesAttempted: All discovery URLs, request methods, status/outcomes, and configuration observations are recorded in city-375-almada.json.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/object ID when independently verified
schemaAndCrs: No Almada parcel schema/CRS verified. The unrelated configured São Brás de Alportel source declared EPSG:3763 and fields titular, concelho, area_m2; those fields were not queried or retained.
